And honestly? I keep replaying it. That night. I know it wasn’t entirely their fault, but I can’t help being angry—at my friends for leaving, at the people who didn’t help. It feels simpler to point fingers than to sit with how scared I was. When did this start? I don’t know—maybe a year? A little less? I can’t tell when things shifted. Sometimes I wonder if this is just who I’ve always been.
